items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: You got started with Henry Allen. [INTERVIEWER] I started playing. ... And then Henry Allen behind him, he kept behind him.

ctx.x: You started on Lessons on the E flat or the B flat?
I started on the B flat but I bought it on the E flat at Coyne's or a ramp or a tree, the whole town. You got started with Henry Allen.
